themes.name: Preferred-variant availability
themes.userGoal: Know when a required saved variant becomes available.
themes.barrierOrNeed: Manual stock checking interrupts an active decision.
inclusionCriteria: A required variant is unavailable and purchase intent remains.
exclusionCriteria: General browsing without a preferred variant.

themes.name: Comparison and decision-resume effort
themes.userGoal: Resume a saved-item comparison without reconstructing prior reasoning.
themes.barrierOrNeed: Saved options lose context and require repeated comparison.
inclusionCriteria: Repeated comparison or forgotten shortlist rationale is explicit.
exclusionCriteria: Passive inspiration with no active decision.

themes.name: Fit and size confidence
themes.userGoal: Choose a suitable size with enough confidence to progress.
themes.barrierOrNeed: Size and silhouette evidence is not personally diagnostic.
inclusionCriteria: Explicit fit or size uncertainty tied to a decision.
exclusionCriteria: Post-purchase sizing with no future decision link.

themes.name: Occasion and styling confidence
themes.userGoal: Judge whether a product suits a specific context.
themes.barrierOrNeed: Styling context is insufficient for an occasion decision.
inclusionCriteria: A named occasion or styling requirement affects choice.

themes.name: Product evidence confidence
themes.userGoal: Understand likely material and visual reality before purchase.
themes.barrierOrNeed: Catalog evidence does not resolve material, colour, or review conflict.
inclusionCriteria: Material, colour, image, or review diagnosticity affects a decision.
exclusionCriteria: Actual fulfillment failures without pre-purchase uncertainty.

themes.name: Reversible purchase confidence
themes.userGoal: Understand the effort and timing required if a choice is wrong.
themes.barrierOrNeed: Return and refund uncertainty delays an otherwise active choice.
inclusionCriteria: Return or refund uncertainty is linked to pre-purchase delay.

segments.name: Active confidence seeker
segments.definition: Revisits or researches a specific product but lacks enough fit, material, or stock confidence to progress.
segments.interviewRecruitmentRule: Recruit people who revisited a Myntra saved item at least twice and sought product evidence before deciding.

segments.name: Comparison-led revisitor
segments.definition: Maintains multiple live options and reconstructs trade-offs on revisit.
segments.interviewRecruitmentRule: Recruit people who compared three or more Myntra saved items during their latest active decision.

segments.name: Risk-sensitive decider
segments.definition: Seeks visual, occasion, or reversibility evidence before committing.
segments.interviewRecruitmentRule: Recruit people who delayed a Myntra fashion decision while checking mismatch, occasion, or return risk.
